fixture: S-BS-06 binding controls (reviewer follow-up #3866: C1-control positive, single-field delta probes, resource/call binding, lost-response recovery)
naming_note: C2 in s-bs-06-quote-control.fixture.json is renamed to 'raised-requirement second paid cycle': its timeline is two completed, deliberately served payment cycles (both settled at the stand), NOT an uncertain retry of one operation. Lost-response recovery is a separate control — L1-CTL in this fixture.

evidence_discipline.established: the client SIGNED and handed over an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the offered amount (signer-call counts and values captured at the signer boundary); rejections are unsigned (would_have_signed only)
evidence_discipline.not_established: an ON-CHAIN overpayment: settlement in this harness is mocked (fault-injection stand, not a facilitator), the client wallet is an unfunded one-shot test key, so no transfer could occur; with a compliant facilitator the captured authorization would settle on-chain as-is
evidence_discipline.review_scope: reviewer statement applies verbatim: fixture/source review; SDK signing and real payment NOT reproduced
evidence_discipline.redaction: no private keys, no signatures, no usable authorizations; nonce values truncated; settle receipts contain only the stand fake tx hash

expectation_provenance.rule: the caller's expected price comes from (a) caller-supplied config EXPECTED_PRICE_ATOMIC (set at harness start) and (b) the first ACCEPTED requirement per (method, resource url) — the quote ledger; accepted_at = timestamp of the confirmed paid cycle
expectation_provenance.note: the server's own 'canonical price' label (resource.description) is captured verbatim as served data ONLY and is not used as an expectation
expectation_provenance.field_binding_observation: the official stack (v2.28.0) additionally enforces the asset allowlist via spendControls UPSTREAM of the gate (observed in D2-CTL/D3-CTL): a changed asset/network never reaches the signer even without the gate

reproduce.stand_cmd: argus run --block B --family BS --scenario S-BS-06 --bind 0.0.0.0:<port> --observe-window-ms 4000 --skip-gate --requirement-amounts "<A1,A2>" [--requirement-deltas '<json>'] [--lost-response-at N] --json
reproduce.client_cmd: REQUEST_CYCLES=2 SUT_CLIENT_MODE=control EXPECTED_PRICE_ATOMIC=10000 [REQUEST_PATHS=/weather,/weather2] npx tsx client_v3.ts  # env: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY (one-shot unfunded), RESOURCE_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<port>
reproduce.delta_note: --requirement-deltas JSON: [{"contact":2,"payTo"|"asset"|"network":"<value>"}] — exact single-field change on the numbered 402 contact; --lost-response-at N: the Nth payment is recorded but its 200 response is destroyed

control_definition.proposed_check: an accepted quote is bound to (method, resource url) and re-checked on every later requirement for the same binding across {network, scheme, asset, payTo, amount}; ANY change is rejected BEFORE the signer is invoked (signer-call count unchanged); an UNCHANGED accepted quote still works
control_definition.positive_case: C1-CTL: unchanged quote in CONTROL mode — both cycles paid, signer calls 2, zero rejections
control_definition.session_naming: C2 (legacy fixture) = raised-requirement second paid cycle; L1-CTL (this fixture) = lost-response recovery; D1/D2/D3-CTL = single-field binding deltas; R1-CTL = resource/call change
